title: Event notifier for DAO
tagline: DAO with built in notification service for anything that happens in the organization.
description:
Generally whenever DAOs are setup, there needs to be an additional setup services to handle the notifications regarding proposals submissions, voting periods, voting status, etc. which consumes additional resource( monetory and compuational). 
With build in notification like PUSH, you can drastically reduce the cost generated by those services
how_its_made: Regarding limitations, the push notification has functionality to directly relay the events happening in any smart contracts to specific addresses using their own communication contracts deployed in different networks (testnet, mainnet). Whenever you are trying to deploy anything that does not fall under those chains, you need different logic to handle those events that could’ve been done directly.
